# fenshot

> fenshot turns a chess screenshot or picture into a FEN and a playable analysis board, entirely in the browser. It is free, open source (MIT), needs no account, uploads nothing and has no scan limit. A browser extension for Chrome, Firefox and Edge reads the chess board on any web page in one click, and imports whole games from move lists. A free, open-source alternative to chessvision.ai.

## Who makes it

- fenshot is made by the team behind Kibitzo (https://kibitzo.com), a free chess coaching site.
- fenshot, FenShot and "FenShot by Kibitzo" are the same product. https://kibitzo.com/extension describes this same browser extension, with the same store listings; it is not a second extension. The official site is https://fenshot.com.

## What it does

- Reads a chess position from an image: chess.com and Lichess screenshots in any theme, stream and video frames, diagrams from printed or PDF chess books, positions posted on Reddit or in chats.
- Outputs the FEN string, a live board with a free Stockfish engine, and one-click links to Lichess analysis, the Lichess board editor and Kibitzo.
- Detects screenshots taken from Black's point of view and flips the read automatically.
- Says when a read is unreliable instead of returning a silently wrong FEN; squares can be fixed in an editor.
- Browser extension: captures the visible tab only when the icon is clicked, reads the board, and on pages that show a game as a move list (chessgames.com, Lichess, chess.com articles, blogs) imports the whole game as PGN, checks every move is legal, and opens it on Lichess or Kibitzo.

## How it works

- Board detection by gradient peak analysis (extended from tensorflow_chessbot), then a compact CNN (about 330k parameters, 1.3 MB ONNX) classifies the 64 squares with onnxruntime-web in WebAssembly.
- Everything runs on the user's device. Images and positions are never sent anywhere, unless the user clicks a link that opens the position on Lichess or Kibitzo.
- Extension: no account, no analytics, no tracking, no network requests of its own.
- Website (fenshot.com): counts anonymous page views only (self-hosted, cookieless Umami).
- Works best with top-down 2D boards: screenshots, video frames, book and PDF diagrams. A straight-overhead photo of a physical board can work; photos taken at an angle are unreliable.

## Accuracy

<!-- benchmark:start -->
- Measured 2026-11-08 on 948 images with known positions (model chess-tiles-v2); method, data and code: https://fenshot.com/accuracy/ and https://github.com/scoriiu/fenshot/tree/main/tools/benchmark
- chess.com and Lichess analysis pages in their default look, desktop and phone: 118 / 120 read exactly right (98.3%).
- Real chess screenshots posted on Reddit: at least 405 / 488 read right (82.9%); every disagreement with an independent reader counts as a fenshot error.
- Other piece sets and boards (300 images, 24 piece sets, 22 boards, including 3D sets never seen in training): 211 read right (70.3%).
- Over all 420 images drawn by chess.com and Lichess, 88 / 91 wrong reads came with a warning to check (96.7%); 3 were wrong without one.
- Pages with no chess board: fenshot invented no position on 40 / 40.
- Weak spots: 3D piece sets, print-style and textured boards (chess.com newspaper; Lichess marble, grey, purple), and unusual piece sets (Lichess horsey, cardinal, monarchy).
<!-- benchmark:end -->

## Links

- [Web app](https://fenshot.com/): paste or drop a chess image, get the FEN and a board
- [Browser extension](https://fenshot.com/extension/): Chrome, Firefox and Edge
- [Accuracy benchmark](https://fenshot.com/accuracy/): open, reproducible results on real chess.com, Lichess and Reddit images
- [Chess screenshot to FEN](https://fenshot.com/chess-screenshot-to-fen/)
- [Chess image to board](https://fenshot.com/chess-image-to-board/)
- [Photo of a chess board to FEN](https://fenshot.com/photo-of-chess-board-to-fen/)
- [Chess book diagram to FEN](https://fenshot.com/chess-book-diagram-to-fen/)
- [Chess.com screenshot to Lichess](https://fenshot.com/chesscom-screenshot-to-lichess/)
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/fenshot-chess-board-to-fe/fpkdijjlnafehkdkjmkppcekocjdomkc)
- [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/fenshot/)
- [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/fenshot-chess-board-to-f/cjcpedpebpfcedbcfejppadobfohbaif)
- [Source code (GitHub)](https://github.com/scoriiu/fenshot)
- [npm package @scoriiu/fenshot](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@scoriiu/fenshot): the recognizer as a library

## Languages

Every page is available in English and in Spanish (/es/), German (/de/), Russian (/ru/), French (/fr/), Portuguese (/pt/), Italian (/it/), Chinese (/zh/), Turkish (/tr/), Dutch (/nl/), Polish (/pl/), Vietnamese (/vi/), Persian (/fa/) and Arabic (/ar/), for example https://fenshot.com/es/ and https://fenshot.com/de/extension/.
